name: Steppe agoseris
desc: Steppe agoseris (Agoseris parviflora): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Agoseris parviflora is a North American species of flowering plants in the family Asteraceae known by the common name Steppe agoseris or sagebrush agoseris or false dandelion.
